assets.name: phone-window
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production full-bleed background ONLY for Tick & Kin, a cozy companion focus timer. Match reference's fine pixel-edged painted watercolor, paper grain, soft light and tiny storybook game environment. No characters, animals, people, text, numbers, symbols, UI, devices, border, watermark or pedestals. Preserve the room's identity but RECOMPOSE it for the specified canvas, not merely crop or stretch the reference.
Tall PHONE PORTRAIT canvas, aspect ratio 9:19.5, target 1080x2340. Full room from top to bottom. The upper 13% must be pale and calm behind a title bar. A clear centered standing area for an overlaid character spans x=25–75%, y=21–55%. Put window edges, curtain and flowers at x<20% and x>85%, never across the center. A straight horizontal wall/floor junction at exactly y=56%, with an empty flat floor below it extending all the way to the bottom. Lower 40% is softly lit, VERY pale and low-contrast blue/cream wooden flooring, with only faint broad plank lines, no objects: the timer overlays this area. Compose a charming real room, with airy center, softly painted atmospheric depth, no oval platform. Do not draw the character or timer.
Mochi's sunny window nook: cream plaster, soft blue window trim and pale blue wooden floor, spring blossom branches, cream linen curtains, dappled morning sun.
